title: Higher direct images of a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism commute with filtered colimits of abelian sheaves

difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the higher direct images of a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of algebraic spaces commute with filtered colimits of abelian sheaves (statement lines 696-709, with the slogan recording this reading). The proof passes to the morphism of small etale sites determined by the fibre product functor, invokes the general criterion for colimits along a morphism of sites, and reduces to an affine object of the target, where the fibre product is quasi-compact and quasi-separated and the known colimit statement applies. The reduction to the affine members of a covering is the substance, so the claim is H2.
